# MarkDKBerry.com

YouTube: [https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry](https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry)

Patreon: [https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies](https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies)

---

This was taken from a workflow by "sftawil" on Discord, and adapted here.

It works on the basis of first pass for structure at half size you want to end up at, upscale in pixel space between the samplers, then less steps and low denoise for 2nd sampler at around 1920 x 1080 (or whatever works for you without oom).

This method was used to good effect with WAN dual models in latent space originally, but currently we have to go to pixel space between samplers as there isnt a H3 latent space upscaler that does a good job.

---

Settings will need to be changed to suit your model and loras. and size you can go to will depend upon your GPU

## On a 3060 RTX 12GB VRAM with 32 gb system ram

**5 second video starting at 1280 x 512 (2.50:1 aspect ratio) 8 step lightx2v lora in first pass. Upscaled x1.5 and 3 steps through 2nd pass takes about 35 mins.**

It isnt perfect but its closest I have got to good final results at that size. USDU with HuMO is a close second but it takes another 35 mins to complete at 1920 x 768 x 5 seconds.

## LIMITS (on my 3060 RTX)

**8 seconds starting at 1280 x 512 oomed at 1280 x 512** after saving the "preview" video of the 1st sampler. You can then load that video up and finish it off through the 2nd sampler with cleared VRAM and same seed, does work but its not ideal long-term.

**1120 x 448 x 8 secs with 1.5 multiple in the NVIDIA upscaler using int8 model finished without oom**. Took 42 mins. Result was good enough.

**I was able to do 1280 x 512 x 8 seconds using the w4a8 model** though and it finished in 55 mins. I dont know if it was better than the 1120 x 448 x 8 seconds version, they were close contenders so needs more test. but it didn't oom.

## THINGS TO TRY IF YOU OOM

Oom is the issue, otherwise using H3 model for upscaling would be the solution. Some things to try which I havent yet tested but might bring VRAM use down and push resolution up

- w4a8 model (I was using int8 pruned for quality, w4a8 will take same time but use slightly less VRAM at cost of quality but offers increased resolution so might work)
- set ref images to match not max (I was using max in tests above)
- finding a way to properly clear the VRAM fully between samplers after the upscaler (I used my usual methods but it left something in the VRAM).
- 3 sampler solution might work even better at lower resolution. untested.

# MiniMax H3 FL2VA 三阶稳定版

**PASS 1 → ×1.5 → PASS 2 → ×1.5 → PASS 3**

- PASS1：8 steps / denoise 1.00
- PASS2：4-Step 模型 / 4 steps / denoise 0.65
- PASS3：同一 4-Step 模型 / 4 steps / denoise 0.65
- PASS1 实际宽高自动按原比例压到 **128 网格**。
- 因此连续两次 1.5× 后，PASS2 / PASS3 都天然满足 H3 32 网格。
- PASS2、PASS3 都分别按本阶真实尺寸重建 Conditioning。
- 不复用旧尺寸 Conditioning，不再造成 video rows token 数量不一致。
- 原模型、LoRA、CLIP、Video VAE、Audio VAE 全部不改。

# MiniMax H3 FL2VA 三阶高清重采样

**固定结构：PASS 1 → ×1.5 → PASS 2 → ×1.5 → PASS 3**

### 模型与采样
- PASS 1：保持你当前第一阶模型链，8 steps，denoise = **1.00**。
- PASS 2：保持你当前第二阶 **4-Step 模型**，4 steps，denoise = **0.65**。
- PASS 3：继续复用 PASS 2 的同一条 **4-Step 模型链**，4 steps，denoise = **0.65**。
- 所有原有模型、LoRA、CLIP、Video VAE、Audio VAE 名称和权重保持不变。

### 放大
- PASS 1 → PASS 2：RTX **1.5×**。
- PASS 2 → PASS 3：RTX **1.5×**。
- 三阶在 1.5× 后只做 **8px + 8px 的上下画布补边**，用于满足 H3 patchify 网格；画面内容本身没有再次缩放。

### Conditioning
- PASS 2 按二阶实际尺寸重建 Conditioning。
- PASS 3 按三阶最终实际尺寸再次重建 Conditioning。
- 最终音频继续使用 PASS 1 音频。

# 为什么这次这样修

H3 的 keyframe Conditioning 和正在采样的视频 latent，空间 token 数必须完全一致。

前一版把 PASS2 Conditioning 直接给 PASS3，虽然绕开 patchify，但二阶与三阶分辨率不同，所以出现：
`[2754,96] cannot be broadcast to [6314,96]`。

本版不再复用 PASS2 Conditioning，而是恢复 **PASS3 独立 Conditioning**；同时把 PASS1 的实际宽高自动对齐到 **128 网格**，这样两次严格 1.5× 后，PASS3 自身就是合法的 32 网格尺寸，不需要固定 8px padding。

**结果：PASS3 latent 尺寸 = PASS3 Conditioning keyframe latent 尺寸。**
nodes.title: 最终修复｜解决 PASS3 patchify + token shape mismatch

# H3 尺寸安全修复

**本版没有更换任何模型、LoRA、CLIP、Video VAE、Audio VAE。**

报错 `shape ... is invalid for input of size ...` 的根因是 H3 视频 latent 的空间尺寸没有满足 patchify 的整除要求。

### 已自动处理
- PASS1 宽高先自动吸附到 **64 的倍数**。
- 本 1.5× 工作流因此在 PASS2 后仍然保持 **32 的倍数**。
- 默认 1280×720 改为实际安全的 **1280×704**。
- PASS2 Conditioning 继续读取放大后的实际宽高，不再出现参考关键帧和目标 latent 尺寸不一致。

**建议不要绕过两个“自动对齐 64”节点。**

This branch uses MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo with the FL2VA model family.

Recommended: keep the first-pass audio for the final export. Audio generated again during PASS 2/PASS 3 is an experimental comparison only.

Pixel stages are 1.5x. PASS 3 is deliberately conservative; for lip-sync or speech-driven shots use denoise 0.15–0.25 or stop at PASS 2.

EasyCache and Spectrum are not enabled by default. Enable them only as locked-seed AB tests.
